title: Conduvera GateExecutionReceipt (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Append-only receipt of ONE gate execution under ONE assurance class. `result` is the executor's per-execution observation (PASS|FAIL|ERROR|SKIPPED|UNAVAILABLE) and is NEVER a global GateOutcome: no object in this protocol carries a global gate outcome, and merge decisions remain in conduvera-core. Receipts carry assurance_class because two assurance classes never share an execution key and their results are never merged. PASS receipts MUST carry at least one evidence reference (content_sha256-bound); SKIPPED receipts MUST carry a typed GateSkipReason - skipping is never silent. content_sha256 binds the canonical receipt content: 'sha256:' + lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 compact JSON (separators ',' ':', sort_keys) of the receipt object with content_sha256 removed.

assurance_class.description: Assurance class of THIS execution; two classes never share a key and never merge results.

result.description: Per-execution observation only - never a global GateOutcome.

evidence_refs.description: Content-bound evidence; at least one required for PASS.
